details: Ripple has reportedly secured a final US bank charter, enabling broader financial services. Concurrently, the company announced partnerships including integrating RLUSD into Robinhood for its 29 million customers and a collaboration with C2FO to leverage the XRP Ledger for faster global payments. These moves significantly expand XRP's utility and institutional adoption.
title: Ripple Secures US Bank Charter, Boosts Partnerships

details: Bitcoin briefly dipped below $80,000 ahead of the Federal Reserve's decision and upcoming midterms, reflecting market caution. However, Galaxy Digital expressed a bullish outlook, predicting Bitcoin could reach $125,000, signaling an end to the bear market. Meanwhile, Bitcoin whales have reportedly turned net short on Hyperliquid for the first time since March, indicating potential short-term bearish sentiment from large holders.
sourceName: Bitcoin.com (for Galaxy prediction), Blockchair (aggregating various sources for price dip), Crypto.news (for whale sentiment)
title: Bitcoin Market Navigates $80K Mark Amid Mixed Signals

details: Ethereum developers have postponed the Glamsterdam testnet fork due to gas security flaws identified by ChainSecurity, highlighting ongoing efforts to ensure network robustness. Separately, a wallet associated with the April Drift Protocol exploit transferred $61 million in Ethereum to the crypto mixer Tornado Cash on Tuesday, raising concerns about fund traceability and security.
title: Ethereum Testnet Delay and Security Concerns

details: South Korea is reportedly considering another suspension of its cryptocurrency tax, potentially pushing the implementation date further to 2029. This legislative review aims to provide a more favorable environment for crypto investors and businesses in the country.
title: South Korea Considers Suspending Crypto Tax Again

details: Decentralized cloud computing platform Akash Network is reportedly moving its operations from the Cosmos ecosystem to Solana. This migration is expected to bring new functionalities and increased activity to the Solana blockchain, further expanding its growing ecosystem.
title: Akash Network Migrates to Solana, Bolstering Ecosystem
